title: Wide Mouth Mason Jars - 32 oz, 12 Pack Large Glass Jars with Airtight Lids, 1 Quart for Pickling, Canning, Fermenting and Food Storage, Microwave & Dishwasher Safe
description:
About this item
High-Quality Glass Jars --- Our heavy duty mason jars are made of thick soda-lime glass, which is resistant to breaking, durable, and microwave and dishwasher safe. Each quart glass jar is embossed and graduated, beautifully delicate, easy to grip. And all wide mouth mason jars are BPA-free, non-toxic, lead-free for long-time safe use. Seals Tight --- With the help of BPA-free plastisol in silver lids to isolate the air from entering the jar, The 2-piece airtight lids are proven to keep food fresh longer and taste fresher. Making the 32oz airtight mason jars particularly suitable for canning, fermenting and preserving.
32 OZ Wide Mouth Mason Jar --- Quart mason jar is easier to clean, reusable and more fortable for storage chunks of fruits and vegetables. The wide mouth allows easily reaching to the bottom of the mason jar and thorough cleaning by hand with a wet cloth.
Clear Glass Mason Jar --- The quart glass jar ensures the highest visibility possible, easily seeing the jelly jar's contents and determine if they’re spoiled.
Multipurpose --- 12 pieces 32 oz mason jars with leakproof screw lids can be used for several different uses. Ideal for canning, storage, fermenting, meal Prep and craft project. Perfect for storaging jams, jellies, preserves, tomato sauces, salsa, broths and homemade pickles, peaches, peppers and more.You can paint and decorate the classic jars however you want and use them to create party lights. Give your loved ones homemade cookies in these beautiful jars as a unique and personal gift.
